site_description: A community-run portal for the City of Manila

hero.title: Find what you need from the City of Manila
hero.subtitle: A free guide to city services, departments, budgets and ordinances, written by volunteers who live here.

services.title: Services & Information
services.description: City services explained in plain language: what you can get, what to bring, where to go, and what it costs.

governmentActivity.title: Government Activity
governmentActivity.description: The offices that run Manila, the records they publish, and the announcements worth watching.

footer.disclaimer: BetterManila is an independent guide written by volunteers who live in Manila. It is not the official website of the City of Manila, and it does not speak for City Hall.

contribute.title: Found something wrong?
contribute.body: Volunteers write and check every page here, so mistakes get through. The whole site is open source, and anyone can send a correction.
